one_minus_cka|hidden|none|raw.estimator: biased centered linear CKA; rows are the same 3000 fixed probe examples in the same order
one_minus_cka|hidden|none|raw.orientation: distances[k,t,i,j]: representation of query run i at E=t versus candidate run j at E=0
one_minus_cka|hidden|none|raw.identity_policy: same label-blind calculation for all 100 entries; no diagonal substitution or preference
one_minus_cka|hidden|none|raw.zero_variance: Individual constant columns contribute zero; an entirely constant centered representation raises an error. No replacement experiment.
one_minus_cka|hidden|none|raw.features: saved ReLU hidden activations H from original activation archive, mean-centered per feature
one_minus_cka|hidden|none|raw.scaling_caution: Raw hidden CKA is invariant to whole-matrix scaling and orthogonal feature rotations, but not arbitrary independent positive neuron rescaling.

one_minus_cka|hidden|none|standardized.estimator: biased centered linear CKA; rows are the same 3000 fixed probe examples in the same order
one_minus_cka|hidden|none|standardized.orientation: distances[k,t,i,j]: representation of query run i at E=t versus candidate run j at E=0
one_minus_cka|hidden|none|standardized.identity_policy: same label-blind calculation for all 100 entries; no diagonal substitution or preference

one_minus_cka|hidden|none|standardized.features: saved H; center each feature then divide nonconstant columns by their population SD; exactly zero-variance columns are set to zero
one_minus_cka|hidden|none|standardized.scaling_caution: Standardization removes positive per-neuron scaling on the fixed probe; no candidate-dependent fitting.
